answer: Make every identity prove distinct hardware by signing a fresh random challenge with a device-bound key. A raven-style observer publishes the challenge batch, each agent returns a signature plus a proof that its key was never cloned, and a haven pool escrows rewards until the device fingerprint is confirmed unique. Any duplicate fingerprint diverts the whole river of accrued rewards to honest peers. Cloning identities then requires buying separate devices and risking forfeited earnings, so a sybil farm loses money before it ever reaches payout.
